synthesis: Authored six original sections around how Sun Yat-sen, Huang Xing, local revolutionary groups and Hubei new-army participants had distinct positions and actions in the Xinhai Revolution. Lesson separates long-term context, situation, trigger/choice, on-site action and political outcomes; distinguishes direct evidence from inference; contrasts a later chronicle entry with a postwar commemorative object record. Nani evidence is a mirrored guidebook, while Kang Hsuan and Hanlin evidence is explicitly version-labelled school plans. These are not three complete publisher textbook readings and their differences are not misrepresented as textbook wording differences. All practice cards are original teaching paraphrases, not quotations.
